The Knicks host the Pistons at 0-2, with a home record of 0-1 and a two-game losing streak, sitting 4th in the Atlantic and 11th in the East, 2.5 games back of the division lead. Detroit enters 2-0 on a two-game winning streak and sits 1st in the Central and 1st in the East. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 126-111 win at New York on February 19, 2026, the most recent meeting between the teams.

New York is without Jose Alvarado, who is out with an ankle sprain, while Detroit is missing Ausar Thompson (out, ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and is a game-time decision.
